source_caveats: BofA p21 PC 2025 value shares 64.5/23.2/12.3 differ from p16 64.8/23.3/11.9. Main annual table consistently uses p21. P16 unit series shown separately with its own source identifier, not used to derive the value table.
BofA p6 narrative says Arm merchant approximately 28% in 2026; its chart and p5 table indicate approximately 33%. Use tables/charts, do not propagate the inconsistent prose.

Custom Arm value is imputed silicon cost, not external supplier revenue; BofA uses ~75% of AMD ASP for custom Arm and ~1.25x for merchant Arm. Arm Holdings revenue is not the Arm architecture category.

Server value historical estimates materially revised with Arm pricing assumptions. BofA Feb 23 2026 p17 put 2025 Arm value share 11.0%, August p21 has 32.3%, despite similar unit shares 13.6% vs 13.7%. Do not describe this as observed sequential market adoption. Latest-vintage historical estimate, not contemporaneous actual revenue share.
Forecast disagreements are scenarios with different model universes and vintages, not a consensus or statistical confidence interval. All shares are shipment/value flow, not installed base.
